name: wealth-planner
description: Static, no-build personal finance / property-investment planner. The app has no runtime dependencies and no build step; npm test runs Node's built-in test runner with nothing installed. The devDependencies are checks only (ESLint, TypeScript's checker over JSDoc, stylelint), run by npm run check and in CI.

scripts.check: eslint . && node eslint-rules/selftest.mjs && tsc -p jsconfig.json && stylelint "src/styles/*.css" styles.css
